messages.text: During a Tandem party{when}, the account of {name} appeared to be fake rather than a real person being themselves. Tandem's Language Parties Guidelines say: "Be yourself. Fake accounts will be banned." A fake profile misleads learners about who they are talking to. Please verify the account and ban it if it is confirmed as fake.

I am reporting {name} for what looks like a fake account in a Tandem language party{when}. Fake accounts are not allowed under Tandem's Language Parties Guidelines. Learners come to speak with real people, and fake profiles are often used for scams or harassment. Please review the account and take appropriate action.

In a Tandem voice room{when}, the profile of {name} struck me as fake. Tandem's guidelines ask members to be themselves and state that fake accounts will be banned. Other learners deserve to know who they are really talking to. I kindly ask the team to check this account and act if needed.

This report concerns {name}, a participant in a Tandem party{when}. The account seems to be fake, which goes against the guideline "Be yourself. Fake accounts will be banned." Pretending to be someone else puts other members at risk of scams. Could you please look into the profile and remove it if it is not genuine?

Tandem's guidelines are clear: be yourself, because fake accounts will be banned. {name} was in a live audio party{when}, and this account looks fake to me. Learners should be able to trust who they speak with. I would appreciate a verification and, if the account is fake, a ban.

A participant named {name} joined a Tandem party{when} with what appears to be a fake account. Fake accounts go against Tandem's Language Parties Guidelines and mislead learners about who they are talking to. Please investigate the account and remove it from the platform if it turns out not to be genuine.

Please review the account of {name}, a participant in a Tandem language party{when}. It looks like a fake profile, not a real person being themselves, which Tandem's guidelines say will be banned. Such accounts are often used for scams or harassment, so a prompt check would be appreciated.
